verdict.rationale: Sentry is SDK-based and explicitly says "No agents to install," so it has no evidenced vendor-maintained host, container, or Kubernetes agents. Its only infrastructure-adjacent paths are OTLP ingestion of traces and logs, which can route through the third-party OpenTelemetry Collector, and a few cloud-runtime integrations such as Cloudflare Workers and Convex. missing for 10: vendor-maintained host agent, container/Kubernetes instrumentation, broad cloud-provider service integrations (e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure metrics collection, independent corroboration.
